title: Replacement Eval Trace
description: Per-call eval row for the Big-Base Replacement Track matrix (benchmarks/frontier_open_replacement_matrix.yaml). Composes with schemas/inference_trace.schema.json (Gateway production calls) and schemas/teacher_policy.schema.json (teacher row provenance contract). One trace row = one (model, task, eval_row) cell evaluation. Decisions: slm-learning-103 (compare-and-compete), slm-learning-197 (teacher policy), slm-learning-210 (scaling ladder), slm-learning-212 (7B is not destination), slm-learning-213 (Big-Base Track authorized).

trace_id.description: Unique id for this single evaluation call.

ts.description: Wall-clock timestamp at call start (ISO-8601 UTC).

matrix_run_id.description: Identifier for the larger matrix-fire run that grouped this call. Multiple trace rows share a matrix_run_id; the run aggregates them into the cell-level row in benchmarks/frontier_open_replacement_matrix.yaml.

model_id.description: Model registry id from data/registry/model_families.json (e.g. 'qwen3-coder-next-80b-a3b' or 'opus-4-5').

row_id.description: Eval row id within the task. For HumanEval this is the problem id (e.g. 'HumanEval/42'); for owned-domain corpora it's the corpus row id.

prompt_chars.description: Character count of the rendered prompt (post-template, pre-tokenization). Useful as a model-agnostic length proxy.

pass.description: Did this row pass the task's pass_metric? Single boolean per row; pass@k aggregation happens at the matrix-cell level, not here.

judge.description: Verifier identifier. Examples: 'humaneval_test_runner', 'mbpp_test_runner', 'json_schema_validator', 'opus_judge_panel', 'rubric_v1_handoff', 'trajectory_replay'. Maps to teacher_policy.schema.json verifier field.

judge_reason.description: Optional free-text reason from the judge. For test runners: the failed assertion or stack trace. For rubric judges: the rubric breakdown.

input_tokens.description: Tokens consumed at input. For closed-API calls (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku, Together) this is the API-reported value. For local/Modal it's the tokenizer count.

latency_seconds.description: Wall-clock time from call start to completion-end. Excludes harness setup. Used in cost-per-success rollups.

cost_usd.description: Computed cost: (input_tokens / 1e6) * cost_input_per_mtok + (output_tokens / 1e6) * cost_output_per_mtok for API calls; or (latency_seconds / 3600) * cost_per_hour for Modal hosted. Pricing constants live in data/registry/model_families.json.

fallback_used.description: True if the call escalated through a fallback chain (e.g. local 7B failed, escalated to Opus). Fallback chain detail goes in fallback_chain.

fallback_chain.description: Ordered list of model_ids actually invoked for this row. Length 1 = no fallback. The model_id top-level field is the model whose row this trace counts toward (the LAST model in the chain, the one that produced the scored output).

human_edit_distance.description: Optional post-hoc measurement of the edit distance between the model's output and the human-corrected output (when a human reviewed). Higher = more human work needed. Used for the rubric-shaped task shapes (gad_decision, gad_handoff).

regression_vs_baseline_pp.description: Optional: percentage-point delta vs the canonical 7B Stein anchor on the same task. Negative = regression; positive = lift. Computed at aggregation time, stored here for fast querying.

task_shape_charter_row.description: Charter row classification from slm-learning-103: 1=public-leaderboard, 2=frontier-comparator, 3=owned-domain, 4=lineage. A single trace row counts toward at most one charter row.

tenant_id.description: Optional: tenant_id when the eval was triggered as part of a customer-soul evolution (slm-learning-218). Composes with schemas/customer_soul_adapter.schema.json.

adapter_id.description: Optional: LoRA adapter id if the model was a base+adapter composition. Anchors to schemas/delta_checkpoint.schema.json.

adapter_lineage.description: Optional: ordered list of parent adapter ids. Used for Charter Row 4 lineage rows.

via.description: Delivery channel; sets the cost model and capacity envelope.

promptable_root_context_id.description: Optional: id of the context_root active at the time of the call. Composes with schemas/context_root.schema.json.

delta_packet_ids.description: Optional: delta_packet ids active during the call. Composes with schemas/delta_packet.schema.json.
